note: total_pct_of_wall is a difference of two whole runs, so it carries each run's deferred compilation as well as the diagnostics themselves, and the diagnostics-off run compiles less -- read it as an upper bound. write_steps_pct_of_wall comes from a separate step-breakdown run on the same arm and config, so sampling_pct_of_wall is a difference across two measurements rather than one decomposition. `sampling_resolvable` compares it against repeat_spread_points, the spread between independent pairs of the same code in results/sypd-repeats.json: when it is false the residual is smaller than the run-to-run variation of the runs it is differenced from, so it bounds the sampling share and does not measure it. The 120-step nsys window cannot answer this at all: it is shorter than the 720-step daily write period.
